objective: Perform the "PLANNING" role for work item "Add CSV export to the reporting dashboard".

input.workItemTitle: Add CSV export to the reporting dashboard
input.workItemDescription: Users on the analytics team need to export the current reporting dashboard view as a CSV file for offline analysis. No specific format or column list has been agreed yet.

technicalDesign.summary: Implement a CSV export feature on the reporting dashboard by adding an export action control, retrieving data filtered by the current view's state, serializing the data into standard CSV format, and delivering it as a downloadable file.
decisions: Add an 'Export CSV' button to the reporting dashboard toolbar/header UI controls.
Capture the client's current dashboard filter, pagination, and sorting parameters upon triggering export to query/extract the exact dataset corresponding to the current view.
Implement a CSV generation utility that formats the dataset records according to standard CSV (RFC 4180) specifications, ensuring correct field quoting and character escaping for special characters.
Deliver the generated CSV via an HTTP response with content type 'text/csv' and header 'Content-Disposition: attachment' to initiate an immediate file download in the user's browser.

result.summary: Implement the CSV export feature by establishing role-based access control, building the backend CSV generation service that applies active dashboard filters and formats output per RFC 4180, and adding the export trigger button to the reporting dashboard toolbar.
tasks: Implement access control rules to restrict execution of the CSV export handler and control visibility of the export trigger to users with the 'analytics' role or equivalent permissions.
Build the backend export handler to receive current dashboard filter, date range, and view parameters and query the corresponding dataset.
Implement RFC 4180-compliant CSV generation logic to format query results with appropriate headers, field escaping, and file download response handling.
Add the 'Export to CSV' button to the reporting dashboard toolbar, wiring it to capture active filter parameters and invoke the export handler.
